faq.q: Who does the agent hosting an open house represent?
faq.a: The seller, unless you have your own client relationship with a licensee: BCFSA states a licensed professional must only work for either the buyer or the seller in a transaction and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party.

faq.q: Does the hosting agent have to give me a disclosure of representation at an open house?
faq.a: Not for the hosting itself: Rule 5-10(3), as set out in the Superintendent's November 2017 consultation report, provides that disclosure of representation is not required when a licensee is only hosting an advertised open house or providing factual responses to general questions, unless the licensee solicits or receives information from you about your motivation, financial qualifications or needs.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Open?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Open is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
